verdict.rationale: Cloudflare Workers is presented throughout the evidence as a proprietary hosted platform running on Cloudflare's global network (docs-1, docs-19); there is no evidence of an official self-hosted distribution of the full Workers platform. Community comments explicitly note lock-in and desire to 'run the same code on your own stuff or a small VPS' as an unmet want (cloudflare-comm-10, cloudflare-comm-9), confirming self-hosting the core product is not currently offered.
